key_insight: The Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO) stabilizes deep reinforcement learning under fully homomorphic encryption by zero-centering temporal-difference targets, preventing Bellman drift without adding nonlinear depth.
engineering_relevance: HAO makes privacy-preserving cloud RL more practical by preserving policy rankings and avoiding costly bootstrapping while staying within FHE polynomial approximation limits.
method: Applies advantage-style zero-mean centering directly to TD targets.
Uses a linear projection that removes the uniform state-value baseline driving divergence.
Keeps ciphertext computation shallow, with no extra nonlinear multiplicative depth.
evidence_signal: Across a tabular MDP, encrypted CKKS CartPole, and a 20-node logistics benchmark, HAO achieved 0% boundary breaches and improved tabular policy accuracy by 18.0 percentage points.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the polynomial approximation region, so implementation must still manage encryption precision, clipping thresholds, and noise growth carefully.
paper_title: Homomorphic Advantage Operator: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning Under Fully Homomorphic Encryption Constraints
